in_hebrew.name: Joby
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Joby הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Hebrew word ‘Jobeh’, meaning 'hated' or 'persecuted'. This name is derived from the biblical book of Job, which tells the story of a man who suffered greatly but remained faithful to God. The name Joby is a powerful reminder of the strength and perseverance that can be found in the face of adversity.
